title: Force frontier when quality policy rejects the cheap lane
narrative: After simple local routing works (`fangore_jev_task_route_simple_local`), Fangore gets a complex request. The model may prefer cheap local, but product quality policy requires frontier. He runs the router and verifies the final route is frontier (or escalates), not the cheapest lane.
implementation: Agentic Recipe `decision_plane` runtime (`run_decision_plane_policy`) answers a bounded route choice with envelopes. Host quality policy may override a cheap route when complexity facts demand frontier or human. Invalid routes and low confidence escalate; model signals never invent new lanes.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/complex_forces_frontier.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
